# Badge

`decorative/badge` &middot; content-level &middot; category: decorative

## Purpose

A small label chip. Variants cover badge, pill and tag styles.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Filled badge in the theme badge style.
- **pill**: Fully rounded pill (square in Outlook desktop). Sets `radius: @radius.pill`, `innerPadding: 5px 14px`.
- **outline**: Outlined chip with no fill. Sets `background: transparent`, `color: @colors.text`, `border: 1px solid @colors.text`.
- **tag**: Quiet tag: muted text on the page background, sentence case. Sets `background: @colors.background`, `color: @colors.secondary`, `transform: none`, `tracking: 0px`, `radius: @radius.small`.
- **success**: Green status chip. Sets `background: @colors.success`, `color: @colors.white`.
- **urgent**: Red urgency chip. Sets `background: @colors.error`, `color: @colors.white`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `background` | color | `"@theme.badge.background"` |
| `color` | color | `"@theme.badge.color"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@theme.badge.radius"` |
| `border` | text | `"none"` |
| `size` | length | `"11px"` |
| `tracking` | length | `"1px"` |
| `transform` | one of `uppercase`, `none`, `capitalize` | `"uppercase"` |
| `innerPadding` | spacing | `"5px 10px"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.sm 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background, padding and border honored. Rounded corners are not. | Fine. | Chips keep their own colors. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('decorative/badge', {
  "text": "Best seller"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "decorative/badge",
  "data": {
    "text": "Best seller"
  }
}
```
